effect.mayPauseWhenHidden: This turn runs in the browser tab. If the tab is hidden for a long time the browser may pause it, so the reply can stall until you come back.
effect.runsOnHost: The turn runs outside this window and keeps going while the screen is off. Results are waiting when you come back.
effect.screenHeld: The screen stays on from the moment a turn starts until it finishes, then power settings take over again.
effect.screenHoldUnavailable: This runtime cannot hold the screen on, so the setting stays saved but does nothing here.

allowScreenOff.description: Normal power behaviour. The screen may turn off while the turn keeps running.
allowScreenOff.label: Let the screen turn off

keepScreenOn.description: The display stays awake for as long as this conversation has a turn in flight.
keepScreenOn.label: Keep the screen on while running

session.description: What this conversation asks of the device while one of its turns is running.
session.title: Screen & power

settings.description: What every conversation asks of the device while a turn is running. Any chat can override it from its own settings sheet.
settings.title: Screen & power during a run
